summary: Rubico Inc., a Greek-domiciled Nasdaq-listed shipping company, filed a 6-K furnishing a September 25, 2026 press release setting the record date (September 28, 2026) and Nasdaq ex-dividend date (October 6, 2026) for its previously announced stock dividend of 0.50 common shares per share outstanding, distributed on or about October 5, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued; cash in lieu paid at the September 28 closing price. Nasdaq due-bill trading runs September 28 through the distribution date, so holders must retain shares through that date. Watch dividend-arb mechanics and due-bill settlement confusion.
